sources.title: Lifting Unlabeled Internet-level Data for 3D Scene Understanding
sources.snippet: Annotated 3D scene data is scarce and expensive to acquire, while abundant unlabeled videos are readily available on the internet. In this paper, we demonstrate that carefully designed data engines can leverage web-curated, unlabeled videos to automatically generate training data, to facilitate end-to-end models in 3D scene understanding alongside human-annotated datasets. sources.title: SceneGPT: A Language Model for 3D Scene Understanding
sources.snippet: Abstract Building models that can understand and reason about 3D scenes is difficult owing to the lack of data sources for 3D supervised training and large-scale training regimes. In this work we ask "How can the knowledge in a pre-trained language model be leveraged for 3D scene understanding without any 3D pre-training".
